objectives.description: Sample >=8 chunks across full range plus math-heavy/bibliography categories
Hand-read each sampled chunk, record PASS/FAIL against 4 criteria
Run mojibake sweep across all chunks
Confirm retrievability end-to-end via literature-search.sh (2 queries)

notes: All 8 sampled chunks PASS. Mojibake sweep found 0 genuine corruption (349 consonant-run hits, all confirmed legitimate book-internal acronyms: CPDL, TSPF, NTPP, BRCC, CQDL). Both retrieval queries returned the new doc_id. Chunk-count ratio (758/742 pages) judged plausible. Discovered and documented (out of scope, follow-up recorded) an unrelated pre-existing section_path heading-detection defect affecting 629/758 chunks' navigation metadata only, not content or retrievability.
